availability.routine: an assistant routine that runs on a schedule
availability.unavailable: not available yet, do not set up

defaultView.rule: A view marked as default is the list's built-in view that shows every record: set it up there instead of creating a second view, then select it when you are done so the list opens on it.

fieldTypes.channels: contact channels: email, phone and social profiles

headings.knowledgePages: Knowledge Base pages (outlines only, filled with my own facts)

procedure.askQuestions: Ask the questions at the end first. Leave every unknown empty instead of guessing.
procedure.describePlan: Describe the plan below in plain words, adapted to my answers, and wait for my approval before you change anything.
procedure.readContext: Call get_workspace_context and read the Operating Guide, the existing lists, fields, views and wiki pages.
procedure.reuse: Reuse what already exists. Never create a second list for something the workspace already tracks.

relationship: {source} link to {target} (shown as {sourceLabel} on {source} and {targetLabel} on {target})

roadRules.neverInvent: Never invent prices, amounts, dates or names. Leave them empty until I tell you.
roadRules.noSamples: Create no sample, demo or placeholder records.
roadRules.readBack: After the build, read the result back and tell me what exists and what you skipped.
roadRules.sendNothing: Send nothing: no emails, messages, invitations or posts. Drafts only, and only when I ask.
roadRules.sensitiveData: Keep sensitive personal data out of the workspace unless I ask for it.

routinesIntro: Propose these as a set. Set up only the ones marked as available and tell me about the rest.

workspace.cloud: Create a Customermates workspace at {url} and connect your assistant to it. The template is preselected there.
workspace.connected: You are already connected to the Customermates workspace that will hold this template. Work in it and do not create another one.
workspace.connectedAt: This workspace already exists and you are connected to it through MCP at {mcpUrl}. Work in this workspace and in no other.
workspace.existsAt: This workspace already exists, but your assistant is not connected to it yet. Connect it through MCP at {mcpUrl}, with an API key from Settings, API keys. Until it is connected, ask me to finish the connection before you change anything. Then work in this workspace and in no other.
workspace.selfHosted: Use your own Customermates instance. Connect your assistant to its MCP endpoint at <your instance address>/api/v1/mcp with an API key from Settings, API keys. Nothing here depends on the hosted cloud.
